output.question: Who is Goldman Sachs' CTO?
output.answer: Goldman Sachs' CTO is John Madsen, based on the latest reporting located in this research. Business Insider reported on August 20, 2024 that Goldman had named Madsen CTO after Atte Lahtiranta's departure, and said Madsen would continue overseeing core engineering while reporting to CIO Marco Argenti. As of November 11, 2026, Goldman Sachs' public leadership page opened here does not separately list a CTO, so this identification is supported by the latest available appointment report rather than a current official Goldman biography.

key_facts.fact: John Madsen was named Goldman Sachs' chief technology officer.
Madsen transitioned from head of core engineering to CTO after Atte Lahtiranta departed Goldman Sachs.
Goldman Sachs' official leadership page identifies Marco Argenti as the firm's chief information officer, not CTO.

passages.quote: Goldman Sachs has named tech veteran John Madsen as its chief technology officer, Business Insider has learned.
Madsen, currently head of core engineering, will transition to CTO as Lahtiranta departs the firm.

caveats: The latest direct appointment report found was published August 20, 2024; no newer official Goldman Sachs page opened in this research explicitly confirms the CTO title.
Goldman Sachs' official leadership materials opened here list Marco Argenti as CIO but do not separately display a CTO role.
